blocks.title: Rather write it down?
body: Badger SPILL is our written peer support. Write what’s on your mind, and a trained UW–Madison Student Supporter writes back. It’s confidential.
Badger SPILL isn’t a crisis service. If you’re in danger, call 911, call or text 988, or call UHS 24/7 at 608-265-5600, option 9.

activity.scenario: Sam sits near the back of a 300-person lecture. The professor moves through the diagrams fast, and the slides don’t go up on Canvas until the end of the week. Sam copies what they can but keeps missing half of what’s on them. After class, they go up to the professor.
activity.question: What should Sam say?

options.text: “Sorry, this might be a dumb question, but could you possibly post the slides before class? No worries if that’s too much to ask.”
options.verdict: They apologize for a reasonable request and minimize its importance before the professor can respond.

options.text: “I have trouble copying the diagrams before the slides change. If they were posted before class, I could print them and take notes directly on them. Would that be possible?”
options.verdict: They explain the challenge, identify a practical solution, and make a clear, respectful request.

options.text: “A lot of us can’t keep up with the diagrams. You really need to post the slides earlier.”
options.verdict: They assume others share their experience and make a demand rather than inviting a conversation.

items.title: Navigating Housing
goals: Plan with peers and campus resources
Make housing choices grounded in your values, rights and responsibilities

activity.prompt: Before you sign: what would you do?
activity.note: For education only, not legal advice. For help with a lease, talk to the Tenant Resource Center.

options.text: My own bedroom, in an apartment I share
options.why: Shared private means your own bedroom in a shared unit, like one room of a 4-bed, 2-bath apartment.

options.text: A bedroom I share with a roommate
options.why: Shared private means your own bedroom in a shared unit; you share the rest of the apartment.
Shared private means your own bedroom in a shared unit, like one room of a 4-bed, 2-bath apartment.

steps.scenario: You and three friends sign one lease together. In March, one roommate moves out and stops paying their share.
steps.question: Who is responsible for the missing rent?

options.why: With joint and several liability, everyone on the lease is responsible for the rent of the whole unit.

options.text: Everyone still on the lease, together
options.why: That is joint and several liability: everyone on the lease is responsible for the rent of the whole unit, not just their own share.

options.text: Nobody, until someone new moves in
options.why: With joint and several liability, the rent for the whole unit is still owed by everyone on the lease.

steps.scenario: Two places list the same monthly rent. One adds a deal: a discount on your first months.
steps.question: What should you find out before you choose?

options.text: Nothing. A discount is a discount
options.why: A rent concession lowers what you pay up front, but not the official rent, which can affect later increases or renewals.

options.text: Whether the deal changes the official rent on the lease
options.why: A rent concession lowers what you pay up front, but not the official rent, which can affect later increases or renewals.

options.text: Which place has nicer photos online
options.verdict: Worth a look, but not the key question.
options.why: A rent concession can leave the official rent higher than what you pay at first, which can affect later increases or renewals.

steps.scenario: You will be away next spring, and a friend will live in your room while you are gone. That is a sublease.
steps.question: While your friend lives there, who is responsible for the rent and any damage?

options.text: My friend, since they live there
options.why: In a sublease you are still responsible for the rent and any damage.
In a sublease someone lives in your place while you are away, but you are still responsible for the rent and any damage.

options.text: The landlord, until I am back
options.why: In a sublease you are still responsible for the rent and any damage.
